mapper.sql: From recipe r Left JOIN member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = r.category_id

where.if: AND ( r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM recipe WHERE member_id = #{member_id}

SELECT r.*, m.nickname, c.category_name
WHERE r.recipe_id = #{recipe_id}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY r.created_date DESC, r.recipe_id DESC ) AS rank_num, r.*, m.nickname, c.category_name
ORDER BY r.created_date DESC, r.recipe_id DESC LIMIT 5
